description.value:
You choose up to three creatures you can see within range, each of which must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw. The first time each turn a creature that failed makes an attack roll or saving throw before the power ends, it must roll a d4 and subtract the result from that roll.

Overcharge Tech. Cast with a tech slot of 3rd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for every two slot levels beyond 1st; cast at 3rd, 6th, or 9th level, the penalty die becomes a d6, d8, or d10, respectively.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 1
